explanation:
Implement only the current place stage, starting from the actual partially tilted, still-closed state rather than replaying the raise or interrupted drive. Preserve the previous progress and pending command, then remeasure the visible carton face and identified short end and compare their motion from frame 288 with the actual hand transform through the interrupted tilt. Revalidate the bowl and local closed-finger corridor.

The fixed-pivot assumption is explicitly replaced: use the current measured TCP as the new remaining-tilt pivot, increase translation authority from 3 to 16 mm, reduce the rotation limit from 0.10 to 0.035 rad, and inspect every three-call drive lease. Continuing a short lease requires measured endpoint-residual reduction, or clear angular progress during tilt, and at most 8 mm total tilt pivot drift, already reserved in the fresh rotation-envelope check. Stalls, divergence, mismatch and exhausted finite allowances preserve new measurements and stop, rather than replaying contact or inferring an obstacle.

The saved tilt candidate is not accepted with only negligible fit headroom: test it and at most three 0.06 rad further short-edge tilts, within 0.45 rad total remaining rotation and the freshly reviewed local envelope. Choose the smallest candidate with the unchanged fit margin plus twice the position tolerance, and a drift-reserved clear sweep. If none qualifies, preserve the measurements and block without relaxing the margin. If the measured remaining tilt succeeds, execute only elevated transfer, one optional centering correction, bounded above-lip positioning and separately authorized opening. Preserve the existing 3.5 mm fit/clearance threshold and measured uncertainty model. Reobserve the object after each motion objective, using obtainable face/edge measurements rather than requiring all historical corners or a tracker. Completion requires fresh positive cavity-entry and independent finger-separation evidence, current carton depth inside the uncertainty-eroded opening, and an unchanged upright bowl. A below-lip depth is recorded when obtainable but is not substituted for visible release evidence or demanded from a hidden surface. No withdrawal or settling control is included.
interface:
Python main(api), using only the supplied exact API, np, geo and permitted builtins. Returns stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. No live sensor calls are performed while constructing this submission.

Uses and overwrites the existing place.geometry, place.progress, place.effect and place.revision keys; no additional checkpoint keys are required. Previous progress, its interrupted pending command and earlier retention tests remain in place.revision with provenance. place.geometry preserves measured historical dimensions/opening and stores fresh face/edge geometry and evaluated margins. place.progress records actual entry and action states, pending commands, the latest six compact lease receipts and the whole-objective reference state, differential tests and release status. Full native receipts remain host-owned. place.effect stores the latest raw review, previous partial attempt when present, measurement_errors, and explicit same-frame reused depth samples. Successful samples can replace a failed new sample only without intervening motion and with matching physical surface/bowl identity; fresh successful samples take precedence. References and frames are described in the returned compact handoff.

Remaining tilt permits ten three-call drive leases; transfer ten; one optional centering four; endpoint positioning seven. Each continuation must make measurable endpoint progress, or bounded angular progress during tilt, with budget reserves enforced. Release permits at most four three-step controls and requires two reserved observation calls. Each failed measurement receives at most one distinct replacement. Host control slices may interrupt and continue the live stack; the program never returns yield just for a slice boundary. A repaired entry with an already acknowledged release is blocked for audit rather than reopened.
jev_protocol:
Exactly seven control questions are defined: x,y,z,rx,ry,rz and gripper. Every axis question explicitly reads state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation. Increase maps to positive, decrease to negative and within_tolerance to hold; signs denote world translation or world rotation-vector components. The gripper question explicitly reads state.processed_features.objective.gripper: close maintains the existing command, open requests only an authorized release and keep preserves the last command. All physical commands go through api.drive or api.control and real Jev; answers are dispatched unchanged. Jev is not a depth sensor, identity oracle, geometry calculator or retention classifier.

The host supplies current proprioception, pose residuals, axis relations and bounded magnitudes. Program features supply the phase, measurement frame, carton/bowl uncertainties, 3.5 mm required margin, release authorization and applicable 8 mm tilt-drift limit. Position tolerance is 1.5 mm and rotation tolerance 0.015 rad. The program computes quality, fit and clearance from actual API measurements with geo helpers; these calculations are not delegated to Jev. Reached means measured pose/command convergence only. Actual whole-objective hand states, not drive's last-update before/after, support the differential effect check.

Initial retention is revalidated across all already acknowledged partial-tilt motion. The two physically identified visible short-edge corners are localized by calibrated rays on a current quality-checked printed-face plane. Historical measured length, width and thickness define only a rigid extent model. Missing depths are checked before fitting; one different patch/camera is allowed. Valid partial face or bowl samples may be reused only within the identical observation frame and matching physical identity, with their provenance and both attempts retained; they are not fabricated replacements for failed depth. Face spread is tested relative to noise and used in orientation uncertainty, not as a universal absolute object-size gate. A tracker is unnecessary. Bowl pattern identities can be replaced by distributed current inner-lip samples. A discrepancy above 2 mm with the saved opening blocks reuse, and accepted discrepancy enlarges bowl uncertainty.

Retention requires observed edge motion to agree with the measured TCP rigid transform through geo.attachment_error and observed face-normal change. The positional allowance is 2 mm plus twice the combined edge-localization uncertainties; the normal test includes both spread-dependent uncertainties. The interrupted-tilt feature motion must exceed three times its attachment allowance. Small subsequent centering may establish consistency but is not falsely advertised as a new resolvable retention experiment.

The saved target and up to three 0.06 rad extensions about the measured short-edge axis are assessed, with at most 0.45 rad total remaining rotation. The least additional tilt having predicted centered fit greater than 3.5 mm plus twice the 1.5 mm position tolerance is chosen, rather than pairing a submillimetre fit surplus with a larger control deadband. Each candidate sweep is sampled at nine orientation interpolants using geo.rotation and geo.transform, with half the largest measured inter-sample angular gap, angular stopping and 8 mm actual-pivot-drift reserves. The fixed old pivot is never replayed. Each short drive continuation requires at least 0.2 mm reduction of position error plus measured object/finger reach times angular error, or more than 0.005 rad angular progress during tilt while remaining inside the assessed 8 mm drift envelope. The latter allows bounded initial rotation/translation coupling, not unlimited divergence; final acceptance still requires measured pose convergence. A stalled lease, command mismatch or excessive tilt drift ends the objective and triggers a fresh effect observation before returning blocked. No unchanged stalled contact is retried. All loops are finite and progress is checkpointed before and after leases.

The unchanged greater-than-3.5-mm actual fit/clearance requirement includes measured carton and bowl uncertainties. Fresh post-tilt geometry must still leave at least one position tolerance of centered-fit surplus before transfer or a centering correction. Endpoint clearance targets 5.5 mm after uncertainty, with actual clearance at least 3.5 mm and at most a 65 mm drop to the observed floor. Opening is considered only at the actual endpoint. Its generous candidate guard is built from measured own finger geometry, not an invented actuator sensor; a fresh review must support the local opening direction, guard containment and visible free space. Unknown does not authorize opening. Actual own finger geometry, hand position, orientation and aperture progress are checked after each bounded opening action, stopping at saturation rather than blindly repeating it.

Fresh release effect is assessed separately from pose convergence and gripper delivery: the same carton must visibly enter the upright bowl cavity, not balance on the rim, be independently separated from both fingers, and have a valid visible carton depth inside the uncertainty-eroded opening. A visible point below the uncertain lip is additional evidence when obtainable; hidden bottom support is not invented. Changed bowl pose, lost retention or an incorrect landing requests needs_replan; unresolvable evidence requests blocked with the exact gap. Only the outer supervisor may advance to verification or propose task completion.
